answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities at a harbor. To claim one slot on the jetty, an agent burns a non-refundable deposit of 50 copper units, tied to that slot and checked by two neighbors. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 copper units up front, with no refund if slots stay idle; a fake missing its work loses slot and deposit. An honest agent pays 50 copper units once, keeps its slot, and earns undiluted rewards.
